title: The Abundance Call
setup: Francisco emerges from skill integration to receive cosmic abundance call: universal transformation requiring resource-gathering beyond his current capacity, but he maintains scarcity-mindset viewing abundance as limitation. The Record Keepers deploy the Abundance Resistance Trial, manifesting the Abundance Call where resource-necessity becomes clear. They whisper that true transformation transcends abundance, gathering resources reveals inadequacy, maintaining scarcity-mindset proves cosmic safety—better to preserve limitation-work than risk excess.
symbolism: The King of Disks represents resource mastery and abundance-creation—prosperity visions and resource-gathering. The Abundance Call embodies the choice between scarcity-mindset-only and resource-gathering-development. Two approaches appear: limitation-only (maintaining scarcity avoiding abundance) versus excess-obsession (gathering exclusively resources proving recklessness), with abundance-mastery integrating current-limitation with resource-gathering-protocols.
beat_goal: Francisco must recognize abundance-necessity by confronting his preference for scarcity-mindset approaches, acknowledging that cosmic transformation requires resource-gathering even when limitation-work possible, embracing abundance as wisdom not recklessness, and establishing resource-protocols where transformation proceeds through abundance-gathering despite Record Keeper pressure for limitation-only or excess-fixation.

scene_tone: Limitation-only transforming into abundance-mastery through resource-recognition

The Record Keepers deploy dual limitation protocols. The Excess-Obsession path suggests recklessness-demonstration: gathering exclusively resources proves wildness, resource-protocols reveal inadequacy, avoiding scarcity-mindset maintains abundance, resource-focus undermines limitation. Both avoid the abundance-requirement. Francisco examines his own scarcity pattern: he's become expert at limitation-reconciliation, maintaining limits through scarcity-only approaches, viewing resource-gathering as recklessness revealing inadequacy. But he witnesses abundance-necessity preventing transformation—cosmic healing limited because resources-static, reconciliation-work scarcity because abundance-ungathered, cosmic transformation stalling because effective work requires resource-gathering.
